outcomeNote: Mishna statement with its own illustration.

segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ מְבִיאִין מֵהֶקְדֵּשׁ כִּשְׂבָּה – שְׂעִירָה, מֵהֶקְדֵּשׁ שְׂעִירָה – כִּשְׂבָּה, וּמֵהֶקְדֵּשׁ כִּשְׂבָּה וּשְׂעִירָה – תּוֹרִין וּבְנֵי יוֹנָה, וּמֵהֶקְדֵּשׁ תּוֹרִין וּבְנֵי יוֹנָה – עֲשִׂירִית הָאֵיפָה.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «One may bring a female goat from» money «consecrated» for a sin offering of «a female lamb,» and «a female lamb from» money «consecrated» for a sin offering of «a female goat. And» likewise, one may bring «doves and pigeons from» money «consecrated» for a sin offering of «a female lamb and a female goat; and one-tenth of an ephah» of fine flour «from» money «consecrated» for a sin offering of «doves and pigeons.»

segments.he: כֵּיצַד? הִפְרִישׁ לְכִשְׂבָּה אוֹ לִשְׂעִירָה, הֶעֱנִי – יָבִיא עוֹף, הֶעֱנִי – יָבִיא עֲשִׂירִית הָאֵיפָה. הִפְרִישׁ לַעֲשִׂירִית הָאֵיפָה, הֶעֱשִׁיר – יָבִיא עוֹף, הֶעֱשִׁיר – יָבִיא כִּשְׂבָּה וּשְׂעִירָה.
segments.en: «How so? If» one unwittingly performed a sin for which he is liable to bring a sliding-scale sin offering, which varies based on economic status (see Leviticus 5:1–13; see also 9a), and he «designated» money «to» purchase «a female lamb or for a female goat» and then «became poorer, he may bring a bird,» and the remaining money is non-sacred. If «he became» yet «poorer, he may bring one-tenth of an ephah» of fine flour. Likewise, if «he designated» money «to» purchase «one-tenth of an ephah» of fine flour and «became wealthier, he shall bring a bird.» If «he became» yet «wealthier, he shall bring a female lamb or a female goat.»

moves.summary: one may bring one type of sin offering from funds consecrated for another
illustrates with a sliding-scale offering when the owner becomes poorer or wealthier
moves.about: illustrates the rule of substituting sin-offering funds with the case of a sliding-scale offering when one becomes poorer or wealthier

edges.proposedPredicate: interpret.exemplifies — «כיצד» — supplies concrete instances of a general rule without extending or reinterpreting it; construes is only the fallback

positions.claim: money designated for a lamb or goat may be used for a bird or tenth-ephah if one became poorer, and vice versa if wealthier
